hero.title: Hallimane Restaurant: Savor Bangalore's Authentic Rural Culinary Journey
hero.subtitle: Step into a village oasis and experience the rich, ethnic, and value-for-money rural cuisine that Bangalore truly loves.

about.title: Our Heritage: Authentic Rural Flavors for Over 20 Years
about.paragraph1: Hallimane has been a landmark in the culinary map of Bangalore for well over 20 years. Located in a vintage part of Bangalore, the restaurant features a village ambience with its tiled roofs, natural brick walls, high ceilings and an abundance of plants; Hallimane has been proclaimed as one of the best ethnic and value for money restaurants in Bangalore by the media.
about.paragraph2: Hallimane is a destination for most Bangaloreans who prefer to savor the best of rural cuisine in a rural setting. The restaurant serves fresh, hygienic and delicious rural food, complemented by exemplary service, ensuring every visit is a memorable taste of tradition.
